In detail

The third of the Zuidwest wijken CBS groups together as scoring unfavourably against the rest of The Hague on crime, poverty and welfare dependency. The Hague's own figures are published per wijk through Den Haag in Cijfers and the national Veiligheidsmonitor, a population survey run for CBS and the Ministry of Justice and Security. Large post-war estates on the southern edge of the city.
